description: Trucks that pinged within radius_m meters of a WKT point (POINT(lon lat)) between since and until. Returns truck_id, the ping time and the distance in meters, nearest first. Use it to check which truck was physically at a fuel station or toll plaza when a charge was made.

configuration.query: FROM telematics_log | WHERE at >= ?since AND at <= ?until | EVAL dist_m = ST_DISTANCE(location, TO_GEOPOINT(?point_wkt)) | WHERE dist_m < ?radius_m | SORT dist_m ASC | KEEP truck_id, at, dist_m | LIMIT 20
